title: Please Update README.md to mention new TOOLs
body:
There are new tools that MCP server is showing - `get_figma_data` , `download_figma_images` .

The TOOLs that README.md is showing - `get_node` and `get_file`.

If new TOOLs are different from the older ones then please write about it, for the contextual awareness.
author: sujayxaradhya

comments.body:
Can you check what version you're running?

If you're using the npx install config, you should be able to run `npx figma-developer-context --version`

This issue **should** be fixed in `0.1.6`

---

Whoops, just released an update, `0.1.7` that fixes one errant bug I'd missed in `0.1.6`. Next time you restart Claude it should work.
Yes! It works very well now. Thank you very much.
Awww yea—thanks for the bug report + logs!
